data.name: Naru
data.gender_notes: Naru is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Naru is a Sanskrit name derived from the term Narayana, which refers to Lord Vishnu in his resting form. The name is a compound of 'Nara' (man) and 'Ayana' (rest), symbolizing the divine power that rests in all beings. This name is believed to bestow upon the bearer strength, wisdom, and divine protection. The name Naru carries the meaning “Lord Narayana” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Naru usually hope their child will grow to embody lord narayana and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of divine rest and protection
data.etymology: Naru belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord Narayana.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Naru total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

data.cultural_impact: Naru holds significant cultural importance in Hinduism as a name derived from Lord Vishnu. Vishnu is the preserver deity in the Hindu trinity. Devotional practices to honor Vishnu include chanting his mantras, offering flowers and prayers, and making offerings to his various incarnations. The name Naru highlights the reverence and connection to the divine in Hindu culture.
data.spiritual_significance: Naru carries deep spiritual significance focused on the belief in the divine power that rests within all beings. The name is a reminder of the inherent divinity in everyone, encouraging individuals to seek inner peace, wisdom, and strength. The spiritual significance of the name Naru aligns with the Hindu philosophy of 'Atman' (the self) and 'Brahman' (the divine) being interconnected, reaffirming the concept of the divine within.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Naru is derived from the Sanskrit word "Nara," meaning human or man. In Hindu mythology, Narasimha, a form of Vishnu, is known as the Man-Lion, who protects and upholds dharma. The name Naru symbolizes the human spirit, strength, and divinity within us all.
